adaptive_layers.layer1_fsm: state from agent-visible message only: agent_requested_confirmation / agent_requested_clarification / agent_reported_progress / agent_other
adaptive_layers.layer2_realizer: FROZEN paraphrase bank keyed by (branch, stratum, fsm_state), chosen by per-(branch,task,replicate) RNG. No free-form generation -> cannot inject facts/authorization/policy. For full pilot an LLM surface realizer may replace layer2 but must be gated by the same semantic review.

turn_matched: N0/N1/S/A/P all emit up to 3 user turns; N1 is length/turn-matched to A
